model.name: Wan2.2 ShotPlan 14B
model.description: Wan2.2 ShotPlan with a fine-tuned high-noise expert and learnable hard-cut planning tokens controlled by prompt relay ranges.

prompt:
A coherent cinematic sequence at a quiet railway station at sunrise, the same woman in a red coat throughout, realistic light and motion.
[0%:33%] Wide establishing shot as the woman enters the empty station and walks toward the platform.
[33%:66%] Medium tracking shot as she crosses the platform while a train approaches through the morning mist.
[66%:] Close-up as she stops beside the platform edge and looks toward the arriving train.
negative_prompt: static, blurry, low quality, distorted, discontinuous identity, duplicate character
